title: Tirzepatide as compared with semaglutide for the treatment of obesity
authors: Aronne LJ, Horn DB, le Roux CW, Ho W, Falcon BL, Gomez Valderas E, et al.
population: Adults with obesity and without type 2 diabetes; open-label phase 3b trial of maximum tolerated doses
funder: Funded by Eli Lilly, as stated in the abstract; the sponsor's role was not read.
result: Weight changed by -20.2% (95% CI -21.4 to -19.1) on tirzepatide 10 or 15 mg against -13.7% (-14.9 to -12.6) on semaglutide 1.7 or 2.4 mg; waist circumference by -18.4 cm against -13.0 cm. The trial was open-label and sponsored by the maker of tirzepatide. Gastrointestinal events were the most common adverse events in both groups.
